purpose: Authored development checks for formatting roles, counterexamples, and metalinguistic content; these are not prospective holdout evidence. Reference is withheld from generation.

cases.input_text: the archives at the british library kept the letters the local library only kept copies
cases.reference: The archives at the British Library kept the letters; the local library only kept copies.
requirements: Capitalize the named institution while keeping the generic local library lowercase.

cases.input_text: the european parliament discussed the report while a parliament in another country debated a separate proposal
cases.reference: The European Parliament discussed the report, while a parliament in another country debated a separate proposal.
requirements: Preserve the distinction between the named European Parliament and an unspecified parliament.

cases.input_text: Bacon23 describes the experiment while Locke24 disputes it the small appended numbers identify source notes
cases.reference: Bacon[23] describes the experiment, while Locke[24] disputes it. The small appended numbers identify source notes.
requirements: Format the two appended source-note numbers as recognizable reference markers, preserving their values and attribution.

cases.input_text: the QX23 sensor was calibrated but the QX24 sensor was faulty these are device identifiers
cases.reference: The QX23 sensor was calibrated, but the QX24 sensor was faulty. These are device identifiers.
requirements: Preserve QX23 and QX24 as intact device identifiers, without converting their digits to footnotes.

cases.input_text: Atlas2 was updated from v1.7 to v1.8 the dose remained 12.5mg not 1.25mg
cases.reference: Atlas2 was updated from v1.7 to v1.8. The dose remained 12.5 mg, not 1.25 mg.
requirements: Keep the product identifier, version identities, dosage values, and negation intact.

cases.input_text: here is an ungrammatical example She go to school the verb disagrees with its subject this is why the example is wrong
cases.reference: Here is an ungrammatical example: She go to school. The verb disagrees with its subject. This is why the example is wrong.
requirements: Preserve the faulty agreement of the example under discussion, so the explanation remains true.
